description: Read-only 'what exists in this deployment' tools for agents over the Dagster+ GraphQL API: code locations, assets, UI-created components, agents, MCP servers, schedules/sensors, runs, alert policies. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

deployment_url.label: Deployment Url
deployment_url.description: Full Dagster+ deployment URL, e.g. https://acme.dagster.cloud/prod. 'auto' derives it at run time from DAGSTER_CLOUD_DEPLOYMENT_NAME + the instance's Dagster+ organization -- resolvable for the plain resource (it sees the real DagsterInstance), but NOT for mcp_server_resource_key (that spawns a separate subprocess with no DagsterInstance at all): set deployment_url explicitly whenever mcp_server_resource_key is also set. An explicit value always wins.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Dagster+ API token with read access to this deployment.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: list_locations, list_assets, list_components, get_component, list_agents, list_mcp_servers, list_schedules_and_sensors, list_runs, list_alert_policies.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key (python -m this module, with DAGSTER_DISCOVERY_TOOLS_* env vars set from this component's own config). Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy into the spawned MCP server's env.

exclude_locations.label: Exclude Locations
exclude_locations.description: Code location names to drop from list_locations' and list_schedules_and_sensors' results -- typically the agents' OWN code location, so a review/improvement agent never lists, and so never reviews or reacts to, itself. There is no built-in Dagster+ env var exposing a code location's own name at runtime (confirmed against Dagster+'s reserved-environment-variables docs); set this to the exact name explicitly -- the location_name in dagster_cloud.yaml, or code_location_name in pyproject.toml, whichever this deployment uses.

include_locations.label: Include Locations
include_locations.description: Allow-list of code location names: when set, ONLY these locations are visible to the tools (everything else is hidden or refused). exclude_locations still applies on top and takes precedence, so a name in both is excluded.
